jobs.title: Coordinateur Produit Conseil Sportif
jobs.company: Académie Internationale des Sciences et Techniques du Sport (AISTS)
jobs.description: Êtes-vous passionné par le fait de remettre en question le statu quo dans le sport ? Appréciez-vous les solutions basées sur la recherche et rigoureuses scientifiquement ? Êtes-vous motivé par le développement de projets et d’entreprises ? Vous épanouissez-vous dans des environnements dynamiques et multiculturels ? Alors rejoignez l’AISTS – l’Académie Internationale de Management et Technologie du Sport – et contribuez à façonner l’avenir du leadership sportif. À propos de l’AISTS L’AISTS, l’Académie Internationale de Management et Technologie du Sport, est un centre académique prestigieux à but non lucratif au cœur de l’industrie mondiale du sport. Fondée en 2000 à Lausanne, en Suisse, elle offre une éducation et des services de conseil de classe mondiale en gestion du sport. L’approche multidisciplinaire unique de l’AISTS combine une expertise en technologie, gestion, économie, médecine, carrière et leadership. Avec un réseau de plus de 750 anciens élèves, 100 conférenciers distingués et des partenariats avec des organisations sportives de premier plan, l’AISTS façonne l’avenir du sport international. Située dans la Capitale Olympique, elle sert de pont entre le monde académique et l’industrie, promouvant l’excellence en gestion du sport pour générer un impact global positif grâce au pouvoir du sport. Votre rôle Le Coordinateur Produit – Conseil Sportif est responsable de transformer le conseil sportif de l’AISTS – tel que l’évaluation d’impact, la certification d’équipements sportifs, etc. – en produits clairs, orientés marché, avec des méthodologies rigoureuses scientifiquement et des modèles de livraison allégés. Le rôle couvre deux grandes familles de produits : les évaluations d’impact et analyses pour événements et organisations sportives ; et les services de conformité/certification d’équipements sportifs pour les parties prenantes clés (régulateurs, concepteurs, producteurs, utilisateurs…). Positionnement & Contexte Relevant du Responsable Senior du Portefeuille Produits, vous travaillerez en partenariat avec les professeurs et chercheurs du réseau AISTS. En interne, vous collaborerez étroitement avec l’équipe Développement & Marketing B2B et l’équipe Opérations & Livraison. Ce poste a été créé dans le cadre d’une nouvelle stratégie adoptée et déployée par l’AISTS. Le périmètre du rôle pourra évoluer selon le déploiement de cette stratégie. Responsabilités clés Développement produit Transformer les méthodologies d’évaluation reconnues mondialement de l’AISTS en produits clairs, répétables et rentables tout en préservant leurs caractéristiques essentielles : rigueur scientifique et pragmatisme pour une application industrielle, incluant : -> des produits standardisés d’évaluation d’impact avec l’impact économique comme point d’entrée principal et des extensions vers les impacts environnementaux, sociaux, médiatiques et pertinents pour les parties prenantes/communautés -> des processus indépendants d’évaluation et de certification de la réglementation des équipements sportifs pour soutenir les parties prenantes clés – fédérations, organisateurs d’événements, fabricants et athlètes – garantissant l’équité dans la conception, l’évaluation et la certification des processus, cadres opérationnels et normes de qualité. -> Développer des exemples de livrables, références de cas et propositions de valeur prêtes pour le marketing destinées aux fédérations internationales, organisateurs d’événements, villes, hôtes, sponsors et organisations sportives. Créer un modèle opérationnel plus léger combinant l’assurance qualité de l’AISTS avec des experts externes, partenaires académiques et coordinateurs de livraison lorsque cela est approprié : -> Définir les formats de produits, modèles méthodologiques, besoins en données, livrables, logique tarifaire, calendriers et rôles de livraison. -> Définir ce que l’AISTS peut gérer directement de manière crédible versus ce qui nécessite des partenaires techniques, juridiques, ingénierie ou normes. -> Établir des principes d’assurance qualité, gouvernance méthodologique et standards de documentation pour protéger la crédibilité de l’AISTS. Explorer les opportunités d’application des produits existants dans d’autres domaines tels que les infrastructures sportives, l’innovation avec de nouveaux matériaux, la conformité aux normes émergentes et la certification, etc. Emballage commercial, performance, gouvernance et amélioration continue Travailler avec l’équipe Développement & Marketing B2B pour : -> identifier les clients et opportunités prioritaires, incluant fédérations internationales, organisateurs d’événements, marques, fournisseurs technologiques et sites. -> traduire les produits techniques en supports commerciaux simples, fiches synthétiques, études de cas et argumentaires de présentation. Créer des modèles de tarification et d’effort produit qui améliorent la rentabilité comparé aux projets sur mesure ponctuels Suivre les résultats des projets, la satisfaction client, les améliorations méthodologiques, le coût de livraison et la répétabilité. Construire une base de données des évaluations et résultats au fil du temps pour permettre le benchmarking, les diagnostics récurrents et le leadership éclairé futur. Ce que nous offrons Environnement de travail dynamique : Rejoignez une équipe internationale passionnée par le sport et l’éducation. Développement de carrière : Bénéficiez d’une exposition à une large gamme de projets dans une organisation prestigieuse. Culture inclusive : Nous valorisons la diversité des perspectives et encourageons activement les candidatures de tous genres, origines et expériences. Croissance professionnelle : Accès à des programmes de formation pour améliorer vos compétences et votre développement de carrière. Opportunités de mentorat : Faites partie d’une équipe solidaire engagée à vous aider à réussir dans votre rôle. Emplacement privilégié : Travaillez à Lausanne, la Capitale Olympique, avec accès aux installations sportives et vue sur le lac Vos compétences et expérience Expérience : 2-3 ans d’expérience en conseil sportif, consulting ou recherche, de préférence avec une expérience en gestion de produit ; Grande capacité à transformer idées et méthodologies en solutions pragmatiques et applicables Esprit d’entreprise, avec capacité à formuler des propositions de valeur et tarifications en accord avec la qualité et la mission de l’AISTS Bonne compréhension de l’écosystème sportif olympique et international, en particulier des tendances et défis de l’industrie du sport ; Réseau pertinent dans l’industrie du sport et organisations sportives internationales est un atout majeur ; Familiarité avec l’environnement de l’enseignement supérieur suisse est un plus ; Compétences techniques : Maîtrise de MS Office 365 ; expérience avec solutions IA, gestion de données et CRM est un atout ; Formation en ingénierie d’affaires ou ingénierie ; Maîtrise native de l’anglais ou du français, avec compétence dans l’autre langue (une troisième langue est un plus). Bonne connaissance des activités de l’AISTS et du programme MAS est très appréciée ; Expérience liée au sport (athlète, bénévole, entraîneur ou gestion) est très valorisée ; Traits personnels : Agile, flexible avec capacité d’adaptation en toutes situations, fiable, très organisé et à l’aise avec le multitâche, orienté service avec de fortes compétences en communication dans des environnements multiculturels Formation : Master (MSc) en gestion et commerce (sport), sciences appliquées ou ingénierie avec un vif intérêt pour le sport. Ce que nous attendons Orienté résultats, capacité à percevoir les priorités et orienté client/service. Personnalité dynamique avec de fortes compétences interpersonnelles. Capacité à maintenir une attitude positive, pragmatique et ouverte dans des situations stressantes et opérationnelles. Solides compétences organisationnelles, analytiques, de gestion de projet et du temps, avec une excellente attention aux détails. Diplomatie, tact et discrétion. Sens aigu de la confidentialité. Flexibilité pour travailler occasionnellement en soirée et le week-end. Nous accueillons des candidats de tous horizons professionnels et encourageons les candidatures même si toutes les qualifications ne sont pas remplies. À l’AISTS, nous valorisons votre potentiel. Comment postuler Nous nous engageons à construire un lieu de travail inclusif et encourageons fortement les candidatures des femmes et des hommes de manière égale. Nous accueillons particulièrement les candidats apportant des expériences et perspectives diverses. Envoyez votre CV, certificats de travail et une lettre de motivation (en anglais) expliquant votre motivation à rejoindre l’AISTS via la plateforme jobup uniquement. Date limite de candidature : 11 octobre 2026. Date de début : Dès que possible Taux d’occupation : temps plein, 100% Lieu de travail : Lausanne, Suisse Faites une différence dans le développement du sport international. Postulez dès aujourd’hui !

jobs.description: At the heart of international Geneva, the International Conference Centre, Geneva (CICG) and the Varembé Conference Centre (CCV) host major events bringing together international organisations, institutions, public partners and actors of multilateral dialogue. Managed by FIPOI, these venues are genuine platforms for meetings, exchanges and outreach for Geneva.   To strengthen our technical team and support the development of our activities, we are looking for: An Audiovisual Technician – Conferences 100% - Permanent Contract   Your mission Reporting to the Conference Service and integrated into an experienced and committed audiovisual team, you contribute to the preparation, operation and reliability of the technical installations of our conference centres. True team spirit (mutual support, communication, constructive attitude), curiosity and willingness to learn continuously; Flexibility and availability to support activity needs, including occasional evening, weekend or public holiday hours; knowledge of the international environment: an asset.   Why join us? Joining FIPOI means becoming part of a Foundation serving international Geneva, carrying a public interest mission and active in a multicultural, demanding and stimulating environment. You will join a human-sized organisation of about 70 employees, where service quality, collaboration and continuous improvement are essential. We offer you a varied technical position at the heart of international events and conferences, professional audiovisual installations, an experienced, supportive and committed team where mutual support and good humour have a real place, large-scale projects serving international organisations, active support for continuing education, as well as quality social benefits and a working environment recognised by the Great Place to Work® approach.   Application We look forward to receiving your application (CV and cover letter) via the JobUp platform. Application deadline: 16 October 2026.

jobs.title: Responsable agence de Genève
jobs.description: Rejoignez Visana en tant que Responsable d'agence à Genève! Une belle opportunité dans un environnement dynamique. Tâches Acquérir de nouveaux contrats d'assurance-maladie et privée. Organiser et diriger les équipes pour garantir un excellent service. Collaborer à l'accomplissement des tâches générales de l'équipe. Compétences Formation commerciale et expérience en assurance requises. Orientation vers les objectifs et motivation. Capacité à travailler sous pression et compétences en vente. 80-100 Ton activité En collaboration avec tes équipes, tu es responsable de l'acquisition de nouveaux contrats dans le domaine de l'assurance-maladie et de l'assurance privée (y compris contrats de frais de guérison, contrats collectifs, LAA, IJM, etc.) et veilles à une excellente qualité de conseil. Outre la conduite et l'organisation des agences, tu collabores activement et sans restriction à l'accomplissement des tâches générales de l'équipe. Celles-ci comprennent entre autres l'acquisition de nouveaux contrats, le conseil général à la clientèle, la correspondance avec cette dernière ainsi que la saisie de mutations d'assurés:es simples. Ton profil Tu es une personne motivée, orientée aux objectifs et à la recherche de solutions. Tu gardes en vue l'essentiel même dans les périodes chargées et tu es très ouvert:e aux activités de vente. Tu habites dans le canton de Genève et disposes d'un vaste réseau de relations dans la région. Outre une formation commerciale, tu disposes d'une expertise dans le domaine de l'assurance(-maladie). Tu as déjà conduit une équipe commerciale. Une formation continue, p. ex. en tant que coordinateur:trice de vente, spécialiste de vente ou spécialiste en assurance-maladie ou en assurances sociales (niveau EP), constitue un atout. Tu en apprendras plus sur notre Visana, du point de vue de nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices Contact Daniel da Silva Nogueira +41 31 357 95 79 Christophe Terre Agent général 032 344 41 20 Qui sommes-nous? Chez Visana, nous façonnons l'avenir du domaine des assurances en mettant les personnes au centre du propos. Veux-tu aussi y contribuer? Alors tu es à la bonne adresse! Avec 922 149 clients/es privés/es et 16 330 membres de sa clientèle entreprises, Visana est l'un des principaux assureurs toutes branches de Suisse. Son siège se trouve à Berne. Nous accompagnons nos clientes et clients dans les situations de vie les plus diverses: santé, prévoyance, logement, mobilité et solutions personnalisées pour les entreprises. Rejoins-nous maintenant. Notre équipe se réjouit de t'accueillir!

jobs.title: Senior Event Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As a Senior Event Manager , you will oversee the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover, ensuring that every event at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Accurate creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. Presence & on-site support: Point of contact for organisers and clients during the event on site, conducting briefings on location and ensuring smooth operations. Interface: Preparation and leadership of internal event meetings to ensure all operational departments are perfectly briefed and prepared. Leadership & quality: Leadership and development of the Event Coordinator as well as co-creation of clear operational standards and templates. Follow-up: Recording all services provided in the PMS/CRM to prepare error-free final billing. Who you are Education & experience: Ideally a bachelor’s degree or training in hospitality, event management or business administration, with at least three years’ experience in hotel events or event planning, preferably focusing on meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment. Organisational talent: Exceptional attention to detail, a confident sense of priorities and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Process & system knowledge: Proficient use of PMS, CRM and event management systems as well as excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills. Personality: Reliable, solution-oriented and resilient; you build sustainable relationships with discerning guests as well as all operational departments. Language skills: Fluent and polished German and English, both spoken and written; additional languages are an advantage. Start date: October or by arrangement. If you would like to help shape the future of the event sector within the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your complete application documents. Benefits At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodation, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous discounts.

jobs.title: Event Manager (80–100 %)
jobs.description: The Goldau Nature and Animal Park delights around 450,000 visitors annually. On 42 hectares, around 100 European wild animal species live. Approximately 200 employees and numerous volunteers are committed to nature and species conservation, education, and research, and sustainably develop the scientifically managed animal park. Do you combine entrepreneurial thinking with a passion for events and hospitality? In this key position, you are responsible for the event business from the first customer enquiry to successful on-site execution. In doing so, you actively develop our event offerings and create special experiences in a unique natural setting. We are looking for a personality to join us immediately or by arrangement as Event Manager (80–100 %) Your tasks You are responsible for the acquisition, planning, organisation, and execution of events from A to Z You prepare and negotiate offers, contracts, and calculations and develop schedules You coordinate events with internal departments and lead or instruct the involved employees You maintain existing customer relationships, acquire new customers, and identify sales and additional sales potential You further develop the event offering and design new, attractive formats for day, event, and seminar guests You manage one employee and coordinate the staff deployed for events Your profile Education or further training in event management, hospitality, gastronomy, or tourism with relevant professional experience Several years of experience in independently planning and implementing demanding events Sound knowledge of gastronomy and a strong understanding of operational processes, quality, and service Strong organisational and coordination skills as well as a structured, reliable, and independent working style Entrepreneurial thinking, creativity, and a good sense for attractive offers and market potential Resilience and calmness, even with several simultaneous events Our offer Responsible role with scope for design and decision-making and the opportunity to actively further develop the event offering Meaningful work in a unique environment with nature and wildlife Diverse event portfolio with different customer groups Appreciative leadership culture and collaboration with committed employees Modern infrastructure and attractive employment conditions with various fringe benefits Application and contact We look forward to receiving your complete application documents, including your expected annual gross salary. For questions, Simon Widmer, Head of Hospitality, is happy to assist you at 041 859 06 31 .

jobs.title: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100%
jobs.description: "Swiss handball strengthens the cohesion of a modern, constantly changing society" To further develop our own events from international matches and cup finals to partner and community occasions, we are immediately or by arrangement seeking a creative, entrepreneurial and implementation-strong personality as: Head of Events & Experiences 80-100% Your area of responsibility Event development & fan experience: You consistently develop our event formats and the entire fan journey. With coherent dramaturgy, entertainment and surprising moments, you make international matches, cup finals and other SHV events special experiences before, during and after the event. Innovation & technology: You combine live experiences with digital possibilities, data and new technologies and transfer relevant impulses from other areas & industries. Event, hospitality and activation offerings: Together with marketing & sponsorship, you identify new commercial potentials and develop activatable event and hospitality offers with added value for fans, partners and the association. Planning & control: You are responsible for concepts, schedules, budgets, service providers and partners and ensure quality, cost-effectiveness and reliable implementation. Operational event implementation: You manage the preparation and on-site execution, keep an overview even in dynamic situations and pitch in where needed. Team leadership & collaboration: You lead a small event team as a player-coach and work closely with marketing & sponsorship, communication & marketing, sport and external partners. In this position, you not only shape individual events but also influence how people experience Swiss handball. You combine creative ideas with entrepreneurial thinking and operational excellence with the aim of creating enthusiasm and sustainable economic success equally. Your profile Several years of experience in the conception and implementation of complex events or live experiences – for example in sport, entertainment, festivals, brand experience or hospitality Strong sense for target groups, dramaturgy, entertainment and the details that make an event a genuine and successful experience Ability to think impact, quality and cost-effectiveness together as well as to recognise and consistently develop potentials Structured, independent and solution-oriented working style with high reliability, resilience and enjoyment of operational responsibility Openness to new technologies, data and impulses from other industries as well as courage to constructively question the status quo and try new things Inspiring, team-oriented personality who provides guidance, takes responsibility and effectively brings together different internal and external stakeholders You do not just want to manage existing processes but rethink events and implement them excellently at the same time. You do not only ask: "How have we done it so far?" but also: "How good could it become?" In doing so, you keep the needs of the fans as well as those of our teams, partners and other stakeholders in mind. Our offer We promote an open, team-oriented culture where innovation, ownership and flexibility are highly valued. You will have plenty of scope for design, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to visibly further develop the event world of Swiss handball. If you want to create live experiences that people will still talk about the next day, you will score a direct hit with us! From winter 2026, we will move: From Olten to Cham into new offices right next to the OYM College, see www.oym-college.ch . Further information about the Swiss Handball Association can be found at www.handball.ch .

jobs.title: ASAP - Marketing & Digital Communications Officer (m/f/d) 100%
jobs.description: As Marketing & Digital Communications Officer, you will support the planning and execution of multichannel marketing and communication initiatives designed to engage a global audience and strengthen brand visibility. This is a highly operational role offering exposure to content marketing, creative production, digital campaigns, webinars, podcasts and community engagement. ASAP - Marketing & Digital Communications Officer (m/f/d) 100% Our client is a leading international membership association operating within the healthcare and scientific sector. Based in Zurich, the organization brings together experts, researchers and healthcare professionals from across the world to advance knowledge, education and collaboration within its field. To strengthen its Marketing & Communications team, our client is seeking a creative and digitally savvy marketing professional who enjoys combining content, design and digital engagement in a mission-driven environment. Description Marketing & Campaign Management Support the planning, coordination and execution of integrated marketing and communication campaigns. Manage content and campaign calendars to ensure consistent and timely messaging across all channels. Partner with internal stakeholders to deliver communication initiatives aligned with organizational priorities. Content Creation & Brand Communications Create engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, presentations and marketing materials. Develop visual assets such as social media graphics, digital banners, infographics and promotional collateral. Ensure all communications and creative materials are aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. Coordinate the production of marketing materials with external agencies, designers and suppliers. Digital Marketing & Social Media Manage day-to-day social media activities, including content planning, publishing and community engagement. Create, distribute and optimize email marketing campaigns, including audience segmentation and performance tracking. Maintain and update website content through the organization's content management system. Support paid and organic digital initiatives designed to increase visibility and audience engagement. Multimedia, Events & Educational Content Assist in the production and promotion of webinars, virtual events and educational initiatives. Contribute to podcast and video projects, including content preparation, editing coordination and publication. Repurpose multimedia content into engaging digital formats to maximize audience reach. Performance Analysis & Continuous Improvement Monitor and evaluate campaign performance across digital channels and provide actionable recommendations. Maintain organized marketing documentation, templates and digital asset libraries. Identify new communication trends, tools and best practices to enhance engagement and effectiveness. Profile Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Media, Digital Marketing or a related field Minimum 2 years of experience in marketing, communications or digital marketing Hands-on experience creating content across multiple communication channels Strong copywriting and content editing skills Experience with social media management and digital campaign execution Good knowledge of Canva and familiarity with Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) Experience with email marketing tools such as Campaign Monitor, Mailchimp or similar platforms Exposure to website content management systems, ideally WordPress Knowledge of video editing tools such as Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent Understanding of digital analytics and campaign performance reporting Excellent written and spoken English (essential) Job Offer Opportunity to contribute to an internationally recognized organization Diverse marketing role with exposure to multiple communication channels and formats Collaborative and multicultural working environment Strong learning opportunities across digital marketing, content creation and stakeholder engagement Meaningful work supporting education, science and healthcare initiatives

jobs.title: Specialist Responsible for Customer Relations & Events
jobs.description: Canton of Zurich Department of Economic Affairs Office for Labour Specialist Responsible for Customer Relations & Events 80% Work changes lives – and that is exactly what drives us. The Office for Labour (AFA) of the Canton of Zurich is committed every day to helping people re-enter the workforce, enabling companies to find the right talents, and keeping the labour market in the Canton of Zurich strong. With around 900 employees at various locations, we pool labour market expertise and stay close to people, businesses, and the realities of working life. You don’t work just anywhere with us. You work where your contribution truly matters. How does an Office for Labour communicate so that it is heard? How do we explain complex topics clearly, for job seekers, companies, the public, and politicians? These questions are our craft. In the AFA Communication & Networking team, we develop strategies, produce content, and support representatives in all relevant appearances, both internally and externally. Equally important to us is networking: with events for our stakeholders and with new, attractive channels, we maintain and strengthen relationships – with companies, professional partners, and within the AFA. From 1 January 2027, we are looking for you as a committed, connected personality for our area of responsibility Customer Relations & Events. Your tasks: Overall responsibility and project management for AFA events: programme, topics, speaker management, and event design (logistics are handled by another internal team) Customer communication around our events – from invitation to follow-up Development and design of a new AFA newsletter, including address management, editing, and dispatch Conceptualisation, implementation, and evaluation of customer relations and information for job seekers, companies, and other stakeholders Management of social media channels related to our events Close collaboration with internal specialist departments and external partners Your profile: University degree in communication, event management, marketing, or a comparable field Experience in organising events and project management, ideally in the public or non-profit sector Strong sense for customer relations and stakeholder management Experience in setting up or editing newsletters is an advantage Organisational talent, strong communication skills, and initiative Interest in labour market policy issues Fluent German We offer: You can expect a varied role with great scope for creativity: you will actively help build the Customer Relations & Events area and make a significant contribution to effective networking of the AFA with its stakeholders. In addition, flexible working hours and meal subsidies are standard with us. Your workplace? Central in Zurich, just a 5-minute walk from the main station. Apply now
